## otpUnexpectedErrorMapping variable

OTP Unexpected Error Mapping

**Signature:**

```typescript
otpUnexpectedErrorMapping: {
    readonly OTP_CREATION_FAILED: {
        readonly statusCode: 500;
        readonly responseMessage: "Something went wrong while creating OTP";
    };
    readonly OTP_VERIFICATION_FAILED: {
        readonly statusCode: 500;
        readonly responseMessage: "Something went wrong while verifying OTP";
    };
}
```

## Remarks

Maps OTP internal error codes to HTTP 500 status with generic messages to avoid exposing OTP service implementation details.
